info.title: barcode-service
info.summary: Durable box-scan ingest with a server-authoritative, gapless per-production-order label sequence.
info.description:
Phase-0 box-scan write API. Every write for one production order runs in a single Postgres transaction under a per-PO advisory lock, so the `production` label sequence is dense (1,2,3,...) with no gaps or duplicates even under concurrent scanners or client retries. `scan_uuid` is a client-generated idempotency key: replaying an accepted scan returns the original row with `replayed: true` and writes nothing.

Tenancy: the client never names a tenant. `id_enterprise` is derived server-side from the verified JWT (Cognito `custom:id_enterprise` claim, or a users-table lookup for a Firebase uid) and every write is fenced by it.

Deployment: staging only. The service is not defined in the production compose file, so there is no production server. The public `scan.<domain>` vhost proxies only the exact paths `/v1/scans`, `/v1/scans/stream` and `/healthz`; this document (`/openapi.json`) is reachable only in-network.

Ops routes not described here: `GET /healthz` (503 when the DB is unreachable) and `GET /metrics` (Phase-0 placeholder).

servers.description: Staging public host (nginx exact-path proxy; JWT is the only gate)

tags.name: scans
tags.description: Box-scan write path and live fan-out

post.description:
Validates the body, then (inside one advisory-locked transaction) replays an existing `scan_uuid`, checks that the production order and equipment belong to the caller's tenant, and allocates or validates the next label. Only `production` scans consume the label sequence and count toward `total`; `sample`, `void`, `reprint` and `rework` are recorded with no label and `label_seq` 0 in the response.

An accepted (non-replayed) scan is also published to `GET /v1/scans/stream` subscribers of the same PO and tenant.

requestBody.description: Max 64 KiB. Unknown fields are rejected (400 `invalid json body`).

200.description: Idempotent replay: `scan_uuid` was already accepted; the original result is returned with `replayed: true` and nothing is written.

400.description: Malformed JSON / unknown field (`invalid json body`), or a validation code: `scan_uuid_required`, `id_production_order_required`, `id_equipment_required`, `qty_invalid`, `scan_type_invalid`, `mode_invalid`, `label_seq_required` (validate mode without `label_seq`).

403.description: `tenant_mismatch`: the production order or equipment does not belong to the caller's tenant.

409.description: `label_seq_gap` (validate mode): the asserted `label_seq` is not the next one. `expected` is the server's next label, `got` is what was sent.

get.summary: Server-Sent Events feed of accepted scans for one production order
get.description: Long-lived SSE stream. Sends `: connected` on open, then one `event: scan` frame per accepted scan whose `data:` is a `ScanResult` JSON object, plus a `: heartbeat` comment every 25 s. Only scans written under the caller's tenant are delivered. Delivery is best-effort (a slow client's events are dropped, never blocking the write path); the durable record is the database. Replays are not re-published. In-memory, single-replica fan-out.

parameters.name: id_production_order
parameters.description: Production order to subscribe to (positive integer).

200.description: Event stream. Each `event: scan` frame's `data:` line is a JSON `ScanResult`.

400.description: `id_production_order` missing or not a positive integer.

bearerAuth.description: `Authorization: Bearer <ID token>`. The issuer is read from the token's `iss` and routed to the matching verifier: an Amazon Cognito user-pool token (tenant from the signed `custom:id_enterprise` claim; `aud` checked when COGNITO_CLIENT_ID is set) or a Firebase ID token (tenant looked up in `users` by `id_user_firebase`, active users only). Either verifier is enabled only when configured. Any unknown issuer, invalid token or unresolved tenant is a generic 401.

Unauthorized.description: Missing, malformed or unverifiable bearer token, or no tenant could be derived. Note: the body is written with `http.Error`, so the Content-Type is `text/plain` even though the body text is JSON.

ScanRequest.description: No tenant field: the tenant comes only from the JWT.

raw_barcode.description: Raw scanned barcode text, stored as-is (GS1 parsing is Phase 2).

id_production_order.description: Production order the scan belongs to; must belong to the caller's tenant.

id_equipment.description: Scanning station; must belong to the caller's tenant.

qty.description: Units on the box. 0 or absent means 1; negative is rejected.

scan_type.description: Case-insensitive. Only `production` consumes a label and counts toward the total.

mode.description: Case-insensitive. `assign`: the server allocates the next label. `validate`: the client asserts `label_seq`, which must equal the server's next label (else 409).

label_seq.description: Required in `validate` mode for `production` scans; ignored otherwise.

total.description: Running total quantity of `production` scans for the PO.

replayed.description: true when this is an idempotent replay and nothing new was written.

error.description: Stable machine code or short message.

expected.description: `label_seq_gap` only: the next label the server would allocate.

got.description: `label_seq_gap` only: the label the client asserted.
